summary: German-born US national security adviser and secretary of state Henry Kissinger, who from 1968 to 1977 helped prolong the Vietnam War, secretly directed the bombing of Cambodia and Laos, and backed mass killing by allied regimes in Pakistan and Indonesia.

evidence.note: Born 1923 into a Jewish family in Fürth, Bavaria; childhood under rising Nazism follows
Postwar stint as US Army administrator of a German town; Germany gets most of part one
1968: he leaks Johnson's Paris negotiating position to the Nixon campaign; first consequential act
Operation Speedy Express in the Mekong Delta, first big operation he and Nixon oversaw
As 40 Committee chair he personally approved every covert operation of the Nixon years
Secret Cambodia bombing campaign and its falsified paperwork; dominates part three
Bombing kept going to court the right before the 1972 election; Southern strategy link
Operation Searchlight in East Pakistan begins; Bangladesh genocide is the core of part four
Secret flight from Pakistan to Beijing; China covered mainly as the motive for backing Yahya
Jakarta meeting where he and Ford green-light Suharto's invasion of East Timor
Start of a long Angola segment on his push for covert intervention in 1975
After 1977: consulting firm, Tiananmen stance, Iraq, legal pursuits, ties to modern politicians

notes: Setting order set by reviewer; LA, CN, PK, IN, EG, IL, ZW, TL, IQ dropped by the 6 cap. Lifespan end 2023 from own knowledge (alive at release). scientist-scholar vs writer-intellectual is a judgment call. Chile explicitly skipped by host. weapons-arms-trade = nuclear-strategy/missile-gap segment of part 2. hate-speech for repeated quoting of Nixon's and Kissinger's slurs (parts 4, 6); sexual-violence left out, Bangladesh rapes get only brief figures.
